title: Install the rear main seal and front crankshaft seal

notices.text: Use the current genuine Porsche PTFE rear main seal (0PB-105-249) — it is the updated design and it is what fixes the chronic leak history. INSTALL IT DRY: no oil, no grease, nothing on the lip. It must go in square and to the correct depth, which means the Porsche 9699 + 9699/2 tool or the LN equivalent (0PB.105.249.LN). Do not tap it in with a socket and do not touch the sealing lip with your fingers.

steps.text: Install the rear main seal and front crankshaft seal.
